_doc: Genre target profiles for song_critique / song_improve: what a finished song in the genre measures like on the delivered file. Each genre entry overrides 'default' field by field. Ranges are [least, most]. Calibrated on the hand remix the person approved (naman_freestyle_song2 as this engine measures it: sub -19.4, LRA 2.2, width -18.2, 8.1 onsets/s, 2-5k -22.4, 5-10k -24.2; the desi_hiphop ranges all hold it; a test keeps it so) and on genre conventions; not on commercial reference files (none are bundled). Tone gates (2-5k, 5-10k) are the song checks' own and are not repeated here.

desi_hiphop.words: desi hip-hop: a heavy 808 under the words, a tight groove, a hook that lifts

punjabi_party.words: Punjabi party rap (Honey Singh / Badshah): a busy dhol chaal, a thumping 808, the hook busier and louder than the verse

drill.words: drill: sliding 808s up front, skippy hats

lofi.words: lo-fi: soft low end, relaxed groove

boom_bap.words: boom bap: a dusty kick and a cracking snare, the low end rounder than trap

melodic_rap.words: melodic rap: a warm 808 and room for the melody

rnb.words: R&B: smooth low end, space in the groove

phonk.words: phonk: a distorted 808 and cowbells up front

afrobeats.words: afrobeats: a bouncing log-drum low end, busy percussion
